text.description_html:
Acorn PSPYP, Hand Painted Ceramic Acorn Cabinet Knob

A depiction of its manufacture's namesake, Hand Painted Acorn Cabinet Knob brings with it the earthy colors of fall. A yellow knob with a dark brown acorn hand painted on it, it is perfect for any light weight door though it would look the most stunning on those made of natural wood. It is 1-5/16" squared.

Features of the Hand Painted Acorn Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-5/16" square
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
